result.reason: The added operative language reaches the preferred position: up to six months of reasonable transition assistance at then-current rates, return of Licensee data within 30 days in a commonly used machine-readable format, and subsequent written certification of deletion. The change is narrowly additive and preserves the existing termination obligations. Drafting is professional, though “thereafter” does not specify a firm deletion deadline and the pre-existing clause contains minor grammatical defects.
